input: s and t contain ASCII lowercase letters and # only, with lengths n and m. # deletes the immediately preceding undeleted letter, or has no effect when the current text is empty. All input collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse arrays or accessor-backed collections; node fields, where present, are plain data fields. Strings are ordinary/primitive strings. There is no concurrent mutation or monkey-patching of standard built-ins. Every individual collection length, computed storage count and index fits [0, 4294967295], except explicit -1 sentinels. Preconditions are not checked at runtime. Actual allocation/resource capacity and completion remain qualification obligations, not guarantees from these declared bounds. JavaScript integers are primitive safe-integer Number values, excluding negative zero, NaN, infinities, fractions and BigInt.
return: Boolean indicating equality of the two resulting texts after interpreting every backspace.
mutation_aliasing: Both strings remain unchanged; no output text or stack is allocated. The Solution object retains no state.
numeric: Indices lie in [-1, max(n, m) - 1] and skip counters at most max(n, m). The ASCII domain makes Python character indexing and JavaScript UTF-16 code-unit indexing identical. All integer inputs and computed mathematical counts (apart from opaque Python identity keys) remain within [-9007199254740991, 9007199254740991]. No bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: O(n + m + 1) time and O(1) auxiliary space. The two indices only move left; each input character is inspected at most a constant number of times across helper calls. Bounds use bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time array indexing and amortized append/pop; output and built-in allocation costs are included.

helpers.name: previousVisible
helpers.contract: Returns the index of the rightmost surviving letter at or before index, or -1, by counting pending deletions while scanning left. It reads but never mutates text.
helpers.cost: Each call scans a suffix of the remaining prefix; across the caller, total O(n + m + 1) time and O(1) auxiliary space. Its complete definition is 253 UTF-8 bytes, included in this source; separator newlines are charged in total source bytes.
